findings.evidence: `rg -n "bilinForm_self_add_of_isSymm|intersectionForm_self_add"` shows the generic theorem at line 75 is only used to prove `intersectionForm_self_add` at line 194, while `WeightPolarization.lean` uses the plumbing-specific `P.intersectionForm_self_add`.
findings.fix: Make this helper `private` or inline its proof into `intersectionForm_self_add`; keep only the plumbing-specific lemma public unless a declared downstream consumer needs the generic theorem.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.bilinForm_self_add_of_isSymm` is a public generic algebra theorem exposed from the plumbing API, while the downstream target only needs the plumbing specialization `PlumbingGraph.intersectionForm_self_add`.

summary: The plumbing weight API has the needed polarization and first-difference lemmas, but the PR also exports a generic bilinear-form helper unrelated to the named downstream plumbing target.
